name: Government Data Centre, Lilongwe (primary national DC)
developer: Government of Malawi / Public Private Partnership Commission (PPPC) / Department of e-Government under DIGMAP (World Bank)
notes: DIGMAP article (2024-03-01) described the Government Data Centre under construction in Lilongwe as 51% complete, expected completion May 2024, built on hyper-converged infrastructure (HCI) and designed as the Primary national DC with Blantyre as Secondary/Backup. World Bank results brief (2025-06-23) confirms a new data centre in Lilongwe was constructed for government hosting. No MW capacity disclosed anywhere; capacity_mw stays null per methodology.

name: Expansion of the National Data Centre, Lilongwe (Paul Kagame Road)
developer: Government of Malawi / Public Private Partnership Commission (PPPC) / Department of e-Government
notes: PPPC RFB ref MW-PPPC-494042-GO-RFB (published 2026-02-12) for expansion of the National Data Centre under the Digital Malawi Acceleration Project; project site off/along Paul Kagame Road, Lilongwe; RFB states the existing Production Site is a Tier-III facility and discloses two 160 kVA UPS systems and HCI node details but no IT MW or facility MW. Status planned/procurement until award/commissioning evidence appears.

name: OCL Enterprise Data Center, Kanengo, Lilongwe
notes: OCL operator page (re-verified via web search 2026-08-12) states it built a world-class enterprise data centre in Kanengo, Lilongwe - described as the first in the country - offering colocation from 1 Dec 2023 with redundant power/cooling/network, 99.982% availability target, physical security and continuous monitoring, connected to OCL's national fiber network. No MW capacity or rack count disclosed.

name: MTL Data Centre / DataCENTRE colocation service
notes: MTL operator page (re-verified via web search 2026-08-12) advertises high-class data centre facilities - rack/floor-space colocation, fire suppression, air conditioning, UPS, biometric access, CCTV and continuous traffic monitoring. Directory listing (datacenters.com) places the MTL Data Centre in Lilongwe (C-grade for exact location); TLS-chain fetch caveat noted on 2026-08-12 (curl -k required), content itself not downgraded. No MW capacity disclosed.

name: TNM third datacentre (announced at VoLTE launch, Lilongwe)
notes: ITWeb Africa (re-verified via web search 2026-08-12) reported TNM announced plans to build a third datacentre within three months as it launched VoLTE services (announcement made in Lilongwe). Existing two TNM DCs have little public documentation; location/capacity of the third not disclosed. Status announced; no site/permit evidence yet.

name: Converged Technology Networks (CTN) AI Micro Data Centre, Lilongwe
notes: ITWeb Africa (Feb 2026) reported CTN plans for Malawi's first AI-focused micro data centre offering GPU-as-a-Service; CTN headquarters in Lilongwe. Press announcement only - no site, capacity or construction evidence. Status announced.

name: National Data Centre, Blantyre (secondary/backup national DC)
notes: National Data Centre in Blantyre commissioned 21-22 Jul 2022 (Xinhua official wire, President Chakwera), Huawei-built, hosts government-wide systems; DIGMAP (2024) designates Blantyre as Secondary/Backup to the Lilongwe Primary DC. ML.mw blog (B/C) describes it as Tier 3 by Huawei with ESCOM involvement. No MW capacity or certification detail publicly disclosed; datacentermap.com lists it as the country's sole listed facility.

name: Reserve Bank of Malawi Corporate Data Centre (CDC), Blantyre Branch
notes: RBM Invitation to Bid ref RBM/ICT/BT/01/2025 (issued 13 Nov 2025, bids due 3 Dec 2025) for design and construction of a modern Corporate Data Centre at the RBM Blantyre branch. Status planned/procurement (tender stage); award and contractor not yet public as of 2026-08-12. No MW capacity disclosed.

name: Airtel Malawi Data Centre, Blantyre
notes: DCD (3 Dec 2013) reported Airtel Malawi opened a new data centre in Blantyre that doubled its capacity, with over US$1m invested. 2013 record - current status/address unverified during this run; per methodology treat as operational on launch evidence but flag that current state needs re-validation. No MW disclosed.

name: Korena / 1nga Solutions sovereign AI cloud & data-centre campus, Blantyre
notes: korena.mw (operator marketing page, re-checked 2026-08-12 per methodology) claims a Tier III+ sovereign AI cloud/data-centre campus in Blantyre, Mawatt waste-to-energy power and NVIDIA A100/H100 GPU cloud. Marketing claim exists (A for claim existence) but physical status is unverified: contact phone on page is a placeholder-style number and no independent third-party confirmation found. Recorded with grade U for physical state, status unknown; capacity null.

name: TNM existing data centres (2 DCs, Blantyre HQ)
notes: TNM's 2026-03-06 announcement of a planned third datacentre implies two existing datacentres (headquartered in Blantyre, Southern Region); TNM also built a private cloud on Canonical Charmed OpenStack (Canonical case study, B). Existing DC count/locations have little public documentation (C for specifics); no MW disclosed.

name: ESCOM data centre (lead only)
notes: ML.mw blog (Sep 2022, B/C) names ESCOM among Malawi entities operating data centres (utility/hosting context under the national fibre backbone initiative). No official ESCOM page confirms a public facility as of 2026-08-12; treat as lead only, not a counted facility. No MW disclosed.

name: Mzuzu University data centre concept
notes: Academic concept materials (2021) discuss establishing a data centre at Mzuzu University (new library). No later completion or operational evidence found; web search on 2026-08-12 found no Northern Region datacenter facility. Recorded as C-grade lead only, not a facility; no MW disclosed.
